editorial.blurb: Cilantro brings authentic Thai flavors to life with warm hospitality and genuinely impressive execution across curries, noodles, and harder-to-find specialties.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server (like Jeans) for recommendations—the staff's suggestions consistently hit, and don't miss the Crispy Fried Mussel Pancake if you spot it, as truly good Hoi Tod is rare in Chicago.
